| Language | Tier | Integration | Basis | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ada | Declared or absent | none | compile_only | gnatprove (SPARK FSF 15) is installed and runs when the source opts into SPARK; plain Ada compiles without contract checks unless the solution adds pragma Assert |
| c | Runtime-checked contracts | none | runtime_assertions | assert-style contracts checked at runtime; no formal C verifier is installed in the image |
| cpp | Runtime-checked contracts | none | runtime_assertions | assert-style contracts checked at runtime; no formal C++ verifier is installed in the image |
| go | Declared or absent | none | compile_only | no contract mechanism measured |
| rust | Declared or absent | none | compile_only | plain rustc has no contract mechanism; prusti-rustc is installed but only runs on real Prusti attribute specs |
| xiom | Formally verified | native | formal | xiom-verify --check (Z3) when the toolchain provides it; native contract checks also run at runtime |
| zig | Declared or absent | none | compile_only | no contract mechanism measured |

> Contract results are tiered by the verification basis this image measured (formal / runtime-checked / declared-or-absent). No ranking or composite is computed across tiers. Integration (native / library / retrofit / none) is disclosed per language.
